method: 120 fresh moving poses per population. New scene geometry, visibility, coefficients and equilibrium on every pose. Reuse allocated storage and compiled mathematics. GPU readback and a pose-marked compositor swap of the scaled framebuffer. Camera overlaps lighting. Physical monitor scanout, JS object overhead and driver allocations are unmeasured.

kernelOutputChecks.measure: Full 3840 by 2160 direct, indirect and total RGB channels. Repeat includes pixels, work counts, iterations, modal counts and equilibrium bound. Only ticks 0, 59, 119 and restored 0 were compared at full resolution per family.

movingFilletArithmetic.method: node scripts/probe-shadow.mjs. Two physical floor edges at 21 increments of 0.0001 radians, seven binary64 positions per root compared with rational segment-hit and authored conic decisions. Maximum step in metres.

wholeShadowAudit.probabilities: Uniform reservoir sample of new planar decisions, seed 31. For each, find a single sheet strictly containing the exact plane crossings for all sixteen source/receiver corner pairs. Rationalize the stored binary geometry, before arithmetic.
